URL: https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/politics/andy-burnham-cabinet-bus-fares-b3019216.html
NOTE: Independent (22 Jul, 05:18) — Single bus fares in England capped at £2 from January. Nationwide cap currently £3 until end March 2027. Backed by £454m funding, incl money to allow devolved governments to take similar action. ~£400m from switching international climate finance investment into loans, rest from DESNZ savings. Total scheme cost >£500m, remainder from DfT funding already allocated to buses. Burnham quote as in ITV/Standard. Breaking-news style.
